messages:
Aisha: Heads up — saw a weird negative credit on Feb invoice: 'Commitment credit -3200.00 USD - us-central1'. We don't have committed capacity in us-central1. Invoice: https://invoices.cloudprovider/INV-2026-02.pdf

Marco: huh. We moved a Dedicated pool to us-west1 last month — did we reassign any commitment IDs?

Jules: billing-bot shows a commit transfer on 1883456700: `COMMIT-743 -> billing-account:redwood-prod:region=us-central1` — I thought that was for another org.

billing-bot: Automated notice: Commitment COMMIT-743 reassigned by support ticket #12456 on 2026-02-03.

Priya: We requested consolidation for reserved GPU credits into 'global' to reduce fragmentation. Could that have accidentally mapped to us-central1?

Marco: quick check — `gcloud alpha billing commitments list --filter='commitment_id=COMMIT-743'` returns region: us-central1, project: infra-dedicated. But our infra-dedicated pools are in us-west1.

Aisha: Finance side is seeing the credit applied against infra-dedicated, so it lowered our committed spend — now invoice doesn't match internal allocation.

Jules: action: open cloud support ticket to get commitment mapping corrected and reissue invoice. Can someone paste the invoice lines?

Aisha: snippet:
``
LineItem 12345 | Description: Commitment credit | Amount: -3200.00 | Region: us-central1 | Commitment ID: COMMIT-743
LineItem 12346 | Charge: Dedicated accelerator hours | Amount: 3200.00 | Region: us-west1
```

Marco: that mismatch will make allocations look like double-charge in cost reporting. Tagging @cloud-supplier-support and @finance.

Priya: I'll open internal ticket and attach invoice + consolidated commit history. Also flag for cost forecast adjustment this quarter.

Jules: I've submitted cloud ticket 987654321. Support acknowledged misapplied credit, requested account-level audit. ETA 48-72h.

Aisha: Finance requested we ask for corrected invoice PDF and reversal for the incorrect region mapping. Also please add a 'do not auto-apply' on COMMIT-743 until fixed.

billing-bot: Note: next billing cycle will still apply credits unless 'suspend auto-apply' set.

Marco: ok I'll lock the commitment mapping and confirm with support. Assigning follow-ups: Marco -> reassign commit; Priya -> finance reconciliation; Jules -> cloud ticket owner.

Priya: thanks — adding to tracking doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/finance/billing-anomalies/COMMIT-743

Aisha: closing loop: please update thread when cloud confirms. :thumbsup:
